findings.actual: Chat and ChatStream stay blocked after context cancel while image HTTP GET is in progress; only releasing local image handler allows cancellation to return. client.Get has no caller context and per-image timeout is 30 seconds.
findings.provenance: Production files at 53e86f881 have no diff against 74434f730; inherited source defects, not introduced by this audit task.

findings.actual: StartService holds state mutex over HTTP heartbeat; second already-cancelled request cannot reach context-aware HTTP until unrelated first heartbeat completes.

group.name: ollama_cancellation
invariants: caller cancellation must stop image-fetch work while building either chat request mode
a cancelled request must not block behind unrelated heartbeat network IO under shared state mutex

verification.network: local fake image + Ollama HTTP only, all handlers explicitly released

covered_scenarios: Chat and ChatStream cancellation/deadline while waiting for image headers or image body
legacy Images and MultiContent images; later images and /api/chat never requested after cancellation
successful remote image bytes and data URI bytes preserved together with text in both chat modes
already-cancelled and deadline heartbeat returns without waiting for a blocked unrelated heartbeat
availability reads observe last completed health result without waiting on network IO
optional failures, non-optional errors and recovery preserve availability behavior
existing parallel availability/pull test under race detector; embedding/VLM consumer packages
limitations: Shared SSRF validation (internal/utils/security.go) performs synchronous hostname resolution with no caller context. This group fixes image HTTP request/body cancellation and does not claim to cancel the shared preflight DNS check.
LocalImageResolver retains its existing context-free callback signature; this group does not change storage read behavior.
implementation: Thread caller context through Ollama message/request preparation and use http.NewRequestWithContext for remote images; stop later image work and return context errors from Chat/ChatStream after cancelled preparation.
Run SDK heartbeat outside availability mutex; lock only availability assignment. Each independent heartbeat remains controlled by its own caller context.
